But still, many think that interest comes with doubts because the Haitian capital and surrounding areas remain deeply affected by armed-group violence.

haitian-times.summary: Up to 200,000 business and tourism visas could be revoked from foreigners who sought asylum, in what would be the largest mass visa revocation in U.S. history.

haitian-times.summary: As authorities continue efforts to expand police operations and a United Nations-backed force builds its capacity, the latest violence underscores how vulnerable communities remain when armed groups can repeatedly return to territory they have previously attacked. haitian-times.title: OAS warns Haiti needs help as it prepares to hold elections for the first time since 2016
haitian-times.summary: The OAS secretary general says Haiti needs more security support and faster voter registration as it prepares for its first general elections since 2016.

haitian-times.title: AI-generated image distorts death of Haitian woman, obscuring rural health care crisis
haitian-times.summary: The fabricated image illustrates how artificial intelligence can add false details to real tragedies, making an already painful event more emotionally compelling while potentially diverting attention from the actual problems surrounding it, some family members and residents say.

haitian-times.title: ‘Grenadye Alaso, men mwen’: Spanish coach David Badía takes charge of Haiti
haitian-times.summary: A Haitian Football Federation spokesperson confirmed Badía’s appointment to The Haitian Times Saturday before an official announcement video was posted later on the federation’s official Facebook account. The 51-year-old Spaniard succeeds French coach Sébastien Migné, who parted ways with the federation in mid-July.

haitian-times.title: ‘Ann Jwe Ansanm’: Traditional games offer Haitian children a break from screens
haitian-times.summary: More than 200 people, including over 100 children, gathered for the first edition of “Ann Jwe Ansanm” — Haitian Creole for “Let’s Play Together” — a community initiative aiming to revive traditional Haitian games that organizers say are disappearing from the daily lives of younger generations. haitian-times.title: Haiti makes Bois-Caïman a national holiday 235 years after historic gathering
haitian-times.summary: According to an Aug. 10 announcement from the Haitian government, Aug. 14 will be observed annually as the Commemoration of Bois-Caïman and the Day of Union for Freedom. The decision gives official state recognition to a date long commemorated by Haitians, historians and scholars as a symbol of resistance, unity and the struggle for freedom.

haitian-times.title: US deports 161 Haitians as former TPS holders await return plans
haitian-times.summary: This is the first reported deportation flight to Haiti since U.S. authorities announced plans last month to increase repatriation flights to twice a week, with about 250 Haitians expected to arrive each week. However, none of those aboard the flight were former TPS beneficiaries, Haiti’s National Office of Migration confirmed.

haitian-times.title: Edwidge Danticat’s Dèy steps into the unexpected things we grieve in life | Review
haitian-times.summary: Edwidge Danticat’s Dèy is an elegy — not only for lives lost, but for neighborhoods transformed, two homelands in crisis and our past and future selves.

haitian-times.title: Hochul urges DHS to reverse TPS termination
haitian-times.summary: Gov. Kathy Hochul is calling on DHS to reverse the termination of TPS for Haitians and Salvadorans, warning New York will lose hundreds of essential workers within days.

haitian-times.title: Frederica Wilson-endorsed candidate wins primary to fill her South Florida seat
haitian-times.summary: Oliver Gilbert won the Democratic primary for Florida’s 24th Congressional District, which includes Little Haiti and other Haitian communities.

haitian-times.title: Haitian American Linda Cothière advances to Miami-Dade school board runoff, seeking to make history
haitian-times.summary: The race carries particular significance for South Florida’s Haitian-heavy community because a Cothière victory would put a Haitian American on the board overseeing one of the nation’s largest public school districts. She is running for the vacant District 1 seat that includes North Miami, North Miami Beach, Biscayne Gardens and Opa-locka, areas with substantial Haitian populations.

haitian-times.title: Wasserman Schultz wins Democratic nomination in Florida district with large Haitian population
haitian-times.summary: Debbie Wasserman Schultz won the Democratic nomination for Florida’s 20th Congressional District after a primary shaped by Republican redistricting and a debate over Black and Haitian-American representation.

haitian-times.title: Haiti gets $3M OAS-Japan deal to expand ID system ahead of elections
haitian-times.summary: The agreement was signed during OAS Secretary General Albert Ramdin’s Aug. 16-19 visit to Haiti, where a high-level Inter-American delegation met with Haitian government officials, security leaders and international partners to address the country’s overlapping security, political, humanitarian and economic crises.

haitian-times.title: Democrats disagree over abolishing or reforming ICE at DNC meeting
haitian-times.summary: The Democratic National Committee approved competing proposals on ICE — reform versus abolition — exposing a party rift over immigration strategy ahead of the midterms.

haitian-times.title: An Ohio entrepreneur built a business with fellow Haitian workers. End of TPS now threatens it
haitian-times.summary: Advocates, business owners and top leaders, including Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine, a Republican, have warned for months that the loss of legal work authorization directly jeopardizes businesses relying on immigrant labor, local tax coffers and regional supply chains.

haitian-times.summary: For Haitian nationals who already speak French, Canada’s growing emphasis on Francophone immigration could create additional pathways to permanent residence, work and study.

haitian-times.summary: The Senate has passed a two-year extension of the Haiti HOPE and HELP trade programs, offering the country’s apparel sector more stability after last year’s lapse and retroactive fix.

haitian-times.summary: Teams come from neighborhoods throughout Gonaïves, including Raboteau, Rabeau, Acipha, Seprenne and Lòtbò Kanal. Nearby municipalities in the Artibonite Department, including Gros-Morne, Saint-Michel de l’Attalaye and Anse-Rouge, are also represented. Even the neighboring Northwest Department also features a representative in the championship through Tabasco, a club from Jean-Rabel.

haitian-times.title: Haiti International Film Festival announces 2026 selections ahead of 11th edition
haitian-times.summary: The Haiti International Film Festival has unveiled its 2026 official selections ahead of its 11th annual gathering Aug. 15 in Hollywood, honoring Haitian and Pan-African filmmakers under the theme “Konnesans.”

haitian-times.summary: As TPS ends and thousands of Haitians face return, a psychologist and diaspora leader argues Haiti must prepare not just to receive its people, but to harness their skills and experience.

haitian-times.summary: Musician Paul Beaubrun shared songs from his upcoming album, Vertières, at a Brooklyn listening party ahead of the project’s Aug. 28 release.

haitian-times.summary: Edwin Raymond, the first Haitian New Yorker to serve as New York City Sheriff, was sworn in as Mayor Zohran Mamdani used the moment to reaffirm support for Haitian New Yorkers facing the end of TPS.

haitian-times.summary: A year after its founding, the Federation of Haitian Chambers of Commerce says it has brought together 14 chambers across six countries.

haitian-times.title: Residents question quality of Haiti’s Northwest new road project, call for paved highway

haitian-times.title: Immigration crackdown threatens Haitian caregivers and the seniors who rely on them

haitian-times.title: Doctors Without Borders resumes maternity care at Port-au-Prince hospital
haitian-times.summary: The humanitarian organization announced in a July 29 statement that the hospital has been operating around the clock since July 14, restoring access to obstetric and reproductive healthcare in one of Haiti’s most violence-plagued communities.

haitian-times.title: Loss of work authorization sows confusion for thousands of Haitian immigrants and their US employers
haitian-times.summary: As TPS work permits expire without extension, thousands of Haitian workers and their U.S. employers face sudden uncertainty over jobs, deportation and survival.

haitian-times.title: Haiti defeats Cuba, keeping FIFA U-20 World Cup hope alive
haitian-times.summary: Haiti bounced back from its opening defeat to the United States with a hard-fought 3-2 victory over Cuba Tuesday, earning three vital points to keep alive its hopes of reaching the 2027 FIFA U-20 World Cup. Les Petits Grenadiers will now head into a decisive final group-stage match against El Salvador.

haitian-times.title: White House wants veterans to replace immigrant truckers who lost their licenses in crackdown
haitian-times.summary: As tens of thousands of immigrant truckers lose their commercial licenses in a federal crackdown, the White House is promoting a new program to recruit veterans to fill the gap.

haitian-times.summary: The revised calendar, published July 27 after being submitted to the government four days earlier, replaces a previous timetable that had scheduled the first round for Aug. 30 and the runoff for Dec. 6.

haitian-times.summary: A mix of New York City-based eye-popping tales, titillating tidbits and pivotal points make up the lore — and lure — of Konpa as it became entrenched in the Big Apple along with the Haitian community.

haitian-times.title: Haiti launches voter registration in nine departments, excluding West due to insecurity
haitian-times.summary: Originally scheduled to begin in April, voter registration has resumed as part of preparations for Haiti’s first elections in a decade. However, the exclusion of the West Department because of insecurity and the continued absence of an official electoral calendar have raised concerns about the transparency and credibility of the process.

haitian-times.title: Federal judges keep Haiti TPS in place through July 27, Senate bill fails
haitian-times.summary: A federal appeals court has kept Haiti’s TPS protections in place through at least July 27, denying the Trump administration’s bid to end them two days earlier.
